brief: Native Windows file-operation control: observe progress, stop outstanding work, inspect failures and continue browsing safely.
style_queries: Things productivity calm compact desktop neutral restrained controls
compact neutral productivity utility design system

style_lock.implementation_target: Existing FastFiles Native Precision UITheme/UiMetrics and Segoe UI
style_lock.adapt: Cool neutral hierarchy, restrained blue interaction and compact native secondary controls. Keep existing token roles, fonts and geometry conventions. Marketing hero imagery, large rounded cards and brand-specific colors/fonts are not application requirements.

flows.name: Dropbox Team Folder Upload
flows.finding: Workspace remains usable while a transfer panel exposes status and cancel controls; completion becomes explicit and normal file actions remain available.

flows.name: MonoDesk Team Files Upload
flows.finding: Distinguish queued/uploading, partial completion and completed items; transient success feedback complements persistent file-list state.

screens.finding: Uploads panel groups Cancel all with progress; tabs separate Completed/Skipped/Failed;100percent may still say Finalizing. Do not equate transfer percentage with terminal success.
File name, size, progress and cancel share one row. Prefer explicit native Cancel text over ambiguous X, and avoid the large empty blocking modal.
Recovery action is adjacent to failure; reject the raw untranslated error key and unnecessary blocking presentation.

current_source_observations.permanent_delete: Native MessageBox confirmation exists; needs owned-fixture journey qualification.
current_source_observations.cancel: Backend supports cancelling active and queued requests; main-window Escape route exists. No explicit visible Cancel button found.
current_source_observations.errors: app.last-operation-errors opens a native error message; no dedicated Retry command found.
current_source_observations.not_proven: Queued presentation and recursive-copy completion-count suspicions require runtime evidence before being called defects.

next: Finish acceptance publication/integration; capture actual native baseline before implementation. Own unique temp fixtures only; qualify permanent delete, multi-selection and true in-flight file-operation cancellation. These are separate from index-query cancellation.
